content: Which line of business has the most open claims, and how many?
Claims link to a line of business through their policy, so I'll group open claims by Policy__r.Line_of_Business__c.

name: query_salesforce

content:
**Commercial Property** has the most open claims, with **7** of the 26 open. Personal Auto is close behind with 6.

| Line of business | Open claims |
|---|---|
| Commercial Property | **7** |
| Personal Auto | 6 |
| Commercial Auto | 3 |
| General Liability | 3 |
| Workers Compensation | 3 |
| Homeowners | 2 |
| Renters | 2 |
